title: myceliumr
text: myceliumr R package managing cross-species study data analysis artifacts. provides cohort framework rat/mouse/human projects ortholog-aware annotation lightweight storage WES snRNA outputs. Website: http://www.samuelbharti.com/myceliumr/

title: myceliumr
text: S7 Classes: Study, Subject, Cohort explicit properties validation Manifest IO: Read validate CSV manifests required/optional fields Cross-Species Support: Built-support rat, mouse, human Lightweight: Minimal dependencies, Shiny-friendly accessors Validated: Comprehensive test coverage clear error messages

title: myceliumr
code: library(myceliumr)  # Create a study study <- study_new(   study_id = "PILOT_001",   title = "NF1 Rat Pilot Study",   description = "Cross-species analysis of NF1 mutations",   assays = c("WES", "snRNA") )  # Load and validate a manifest CSV # manifest.csv should have: subject_id, species, and optional fields # Example: subject_id, species, genotype, wes_id, snrna_id parsed <- read_manifest_csv("manifest.csv")  # Create a cohort cohort <- cohort_new(   subject_tbl = parsed$subject_tbl,   sample_map = parsed$sample_map,   study = study,   paths = list(     wes_vcf = "data/wes/",     snrna_h5 = "data/snrna/"   ) )  print(cohort)

title: myceliumr
text: Manifests must include: - subject_id: Unique identifier subject - species: One “rat”, “mouse”, “human” Optional fields: - genotype: Genotype information - sex: Biological sex - strain: Strain breed - cohort: Cohort membership - timepoint: Experimental timepoint - assay-specific sample IDs (e.g., wes_id, snrna_id) Example manifest:

title: myceliumr
text: Represents study-level metadata: - study_id: Unique identifier - title: Study title - description: Optional description - assays: Vector assay types - genome_builds: Named list genome information

title: myceliumr
text: Represents individual subjects: - subject_id: Unique identifier - species: Species (rat/mouse/human) - Optional: sex, strain, genotype, cohort, timepoint

title: myceliumr
text: Container study data: - study: Associated Study object - subject_tbl: Table subject metadata - sample_map: Mapping assay-specific sample IDs - paths: Named list data locations - analyses: Registry analysis results
